Class FastChaCallGraphConfig

java.lang.Object
sootup.callgraph.config.ChaCallGraphConfig
sootup.callgraph.config.FastChaCallGraphConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
CallGraphConfig
public final class FastChaCallGraphConfig extends ChaCallGraphConfig
Stage of the unified CallGraphConfig builder chain for FastClassHierarchyAnalysisAlgorithm, which resolves virtual calls on the type of the receiver local, as Soot's CHA does. Obtained via CallGraphConfigBuilder.fastCha(). Read the algorithm's documentation for the caveats: the bodies of the view have to be typed after their locals were split.
